meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

meanings.note: Usually plural: ухаживания. Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'хаживание'). Verbal action/result neuter noun formed with '-ение'/'-ание'. Common neuter noun meaning 'courtship, romantic advances' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Я уже встретил! Но она отвергает мои ухаживания.
examples.trans: I already have met her! But she rejects my advances.

meanings.note: + infinitive or a noun. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to want', paired with 'захотеть'.

examples.trans: If you don't want to, suit yourself.
They want to build a shopping centre there.
